memory_candidates.content: To transcribe long verbatim texts (blockquotes with unicode, quotes, newlines) from a markdown report into JSON string fields: extract the blockquote with awk stripping '^> ?' prefixes into a temp file, inject with jq --rawfile plus rtrimstr("\n"), then verify by extracting the field back out and diffing against the temp file. Never inline long strings in a jq program; validate with 'jq empty' after every write and snapshot the JSON file first as a rollback anchor.
